content: In Nafsat I, per Melvin-Koushki, Ibn Turka announces that in the next section he will adduce the relevant hadith and translate them so that the padishah understands and can expunge innovation from the realm; the section has two subsections, (1) a Persian translation of hadith and (2) examples from the shaykhs and scholars of the Sunna from the Prophet's time to the present.
